mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate trend over the past 3 months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns show no significant negative correlation with FEDFUNDS (p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5 over any 3-year rolling window, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing starts (HOUST) above 1400 thousand units and real personal consumption (RSAFS) above 720,000 million dollars signal robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in less than 40% of instances when HOUST > 1400 and RSAFS > 720000 over any 3-year rolling window, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production (INDPRO) above 105 indicates strong supply growth, leading to overvaluation concerns and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO > 105 over any 3-year rolling window, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher real GDP level (GDPC1) indicates stronger economic growth, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns show no significant positive correlation with GDPC1 (p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI reading above 3.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting aggressive monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5 over any 3-year rolling window, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous payroll growth above 150,000 (PAYEMS) and unemployment below 4.0% (UNRATE) indicate a tight labor market, boosting consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 40% of instances when PAYEMS > 150000 and UNRATE < 4.0 over any 3-year rolling window, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), higher discount rates reduce equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0 over any 3-year rolling window, or Rank IC < 0.03.
